nodes.summary: A finite family $H$ of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is a linear triple system (a $3$-uniform linear hypergraph, or partial Steiner triple system) when every member of $H$ has exactly three elements and any two distinct members of $H$ share at most one element.
nodes.title: Linear triple systems

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ let $f(n)$ be the largest $m$ such that every linear triple system on $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ (a family of $3$-element sets, any two distinct ones sharing at most one element) has an independent set of at least $m$ vertices, that is, a set of at least $m$ vertices containing no triple of the system. nodes.title: Phelps–Rödl theorem on independence in linear triple systems

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ let $f(n)$ be the independence number of linear triple systems on $n$ vertices: the largest $m$ such that every linear triple system on $n$ vertices has an independent set (a set of vertices containing no triple of the system) of at least $m$ vertices. nodes.title: Erdős Problem 1024: the Phelps–Rödl asymptotic

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$, $f(n)$ is the largest $m \in \mathbb{N}$ such that every linear triple system $H$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ has an independent set of size at least $m$: a set $I$ of at least $m$ vertices such that no triple of $H$ is a subset of $I$. The largest such $m$ exists because $m = 0$ qualifies and no such $m$ exceeds $n$.
nodes.title: Independence number of linear triple systems

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
